title_en: Technology and Engineering (20/20): A Student Robotics Competition
note_en: In 轮到一支队伍上场 "it was one team's turn to take the stage," 轮到 means "it's someone's turn (to do something)": 轮到 + person + action. English builds this around the noun "turn" ("it's your turn to..."), while Chinese uses a verb with no subject at all. You'll hear it constantly in everyday life: 轮到你了 "you're up" or "it's your turn."
